name: Hard-Bench-SST2
description: A challenging, adversarial split of the SST-2 sentiment classification dataset designed to measure model robustness on hard or adversarially chosen movie-review examples. It evaluates whether models that perform well on standard SST-2 generalize to difficult linguistic phenomena, such as subtle sentiment cues, negation, and domain shifts. Primarily used for robustness and stress-testing of sentiment classifiers.
reputation: A niche adversarial variant of SST-2 used by robustness researchers; modest adoption compared to mainstream benchmarks but useful for stress-testing sentiment models.
